words.defn_en: unconcern, lack of interest:

sentences.en: Voter ______ led to a record-low turnout in the election.
sentences.zh: 選民的冷漠導致這次選舉的投票率創下新低。

sentences.en: His ______ toward the project frustrated the rest of the team.
sentences.zh: 他對這項計畫的漠不關心讓團隊其他成員感到沮喪。

words.defn_en: dislike, distaste, hate:

sentences.en: The two neighbors have a deep ______ toward each other.
sentences.zh: 這兩位鄰居彼此之間懷有很深的反感。

sentences.en: Her ______ for crowded places kept her away from festivals.
sentences.zh: 她對擁擠場所的厭惡讓她總是遠離各種節慶活動。

words.defn_en: outmoded, old-fashioned:

sentences.en: Wearing suits to the office is considered somewhat ______ in tech companies.
sentences.zh: 在科技公司裡,穿西裝上班被認為有點過時。

sentences.en: Critics say the band's sound has become ______.
sentences.zh: 評論家表示這支樂團的音樂風格已經過時了。

words.defn_en: sad, pitiful, woeful:

sentences.en: It was ______ to watch him beg for another chance.
sentences.zh: 看著他苦苦哀求再給一次機會,實在令人心酸。

sentences.en: The team's ______ performance embarrassed even their most loyal fans.
sentences.zh: 這支隊伍差勁到令人心酸的表現,連他們最忠實的球迷都感到尷尬。

words.defn_en: indifferent; showing no care, interest; lacking emotion

sentences.en: Many young voters felt ______ about the upcoming election.
sentences.zh: 許多年輕選民對即將到來的選舉感到漠不關心。

sentences.en: He grew ______ toward his studies after losing interest in school.
sentences.zh: 在對學校失去興趣後,他對課業變得漠不關心。

words.defn_en: to be better than; to excel

sentences.en: Her test scores continued to ______ everyone else's in the class.
sentences.zh: 她的考試成績持續超越班上其他所有人。

sentences.en: The company's profits are expected to ______ last year's record.
sentences.zh: 這家公司的獲利預計將超越去年的紀錄。

words.defn_en: confused or muddled in thought:

sentences.en: The ______ clerk gave three different customers the wrong receipts.
sentences.zh: 這位頭腦不清的店員給了三位顧客錯誤的收據。

sentences.en: After the long flight, she felt too ______ to make any real decisions.
sentences.zh: 長途飛行後,她感到頭昏腦脹,無法做出任何正經的決定。

words.defn_en: not influenced by strong emotion; impartial:
words.defn_zh: 冷靜客觀的;不帶感情的

sentences.en: The judge gave a ______ assessment of the evidence.
sentences.zh: 法官對證據給出了冷靜客觀的評估。

sentences.en: She remained ______ even while discussing her own case.
sentences.zh: 即使在討論自己的案件時,她仍保持不帶感情的態度。

words.defn_en: sensitivity to another's feelings as if they were one's own:

sentences.en: Good nurses show great ______ toward their patients' fears.
sentences.zh: 優秀的護理師對病人的恐懼展現出高度的同理心。

sentences.en: Her ______ for the refugees inspired her to volunteer at the shelter.
sentences.zh: 她對難民的同理心促使她到收容所擔任志工。

words.defn_en: in passing; incidentally:

sentences.en: He mentioned the merger ______ during an unrelated meeting.
sentences.zh: 他在一場不相關的會議中順帶一提地提到了這次併購。

sentences.en: The author addresses the controversy only ______ in a footnote.
sentences.zh: 這位作者只在一個註腳中順帶提及這場爭議。

words.defn_en: an embarrassing social mistake:

sentences.en: Calling her by the wrong name was an unfortunate ______ .
sentences.zh: 叫錯她的名字是一次令人尷尬的社交失誤。

sentences.en: He committed a cultural ______ by not removing his shoes.
sentences.zh: 他因沒有脫鞋而犯下了一次文化上的失禮。

words.defn_en: impossible to travel along or through:

sentences.en: Heavy snow made the mountain road ______ .
sentences.zh: 大雪讓這條山路無法通行。

sentences.en: Fallen trees rendered the trail ______ after the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴風雨過後,倒下的樹木讓這條步道無法通行。

words.defn_en: a situation in which no progress is possible; a deadlock:

sentences.en: Negotiations reached an ______ over wages.
sentences.zh: 這場談判在薪資問題上陷入了僵局。

sentences.en: The two countries remained at an ______ for months.
sentences.zh: 這兩個國家陷入僵局長達數月之久。

words.defn_en: filled with intense emotion; passionate:

sentences.en: Her ______ plea moved the entire council to reconsider.
sentences.zh: 她充滿激情的懇求讓整個議會重新考慮。

sentences.en: He delivered an ______ defense of his controversial theory.
sentences.zh: 他慷慨激昂地為自己具爭議性的理論辯護。

words.defn_en: a therapist who manipulates the skeleton and muscles:

sentences.en: She visited an ______ to relieve the chronic pain in her lower back.
sentences.zh: 她去看了一位整骨師,以緩解她下背部的慢性疼痛。

sentences.en: The ______ used gentle manipulation techniques to realign his spine.
sentences.zh: 這位整骨師運用溫和的手法來調整他的脊椎排列。

words.defn_en: adequate but not excellent; able to be traveled on:

sentences.en: His French was ______ , though far from fluent.
sentences.zh: 他的法語尚可,但遠遠稱不上流利。

sentences.en: The road remained ______ despite the heavy snow.
sentences.zh: 儘管下了大雪,這條路依然可以通行。

words.defn_en: showing strong feelings or enthusiasm:
words.root_note: passio (suffering, feeling), from Latin pati (to suffer)

sentences.en: She has always been ______ about protecting endangered species.
sentences.zh: 她一直對保護瀕危物種充滿熱情。

sentences.en: His ______ speech moved the entire audience to tears.
sentences.zh: 他充滿激情的演講讓全場觀眾都感動落淚。

words.defn_en: accepting what happens without resistance; not participating actively:
words.root_note: passivus (capable of feeling), from Latin pati (to suffer)

sentences.en: He remained ______ while others made all the decisions.
sentences.zh: 當其他人做出所有決定時,他始終保持被動。

sentences.en: The therapy encourages patients to move from ______ to active recovery.
sentences.zh: 這項療法鼓勵病人從被動轉向積極的康復。

words.defn_en: readily seen or understood, clear:

sentences.en: It was ______ from her expression that she disagreed with the plan.
sentences.zh: 從她的表情就能明顯看出她不贊同這項計畫。

sentences.en: The judge called the contract's unfair terms ______ly obvious.
sentences.zh: 法官指出這份合約中不公平的條款顯而易見。

words.defn_en: relating to the study of diseases:

sentences.en: His ______ fear of germs affected every part of his daily routine.
sentences.zh: 他病態般對細菌的恐懼影響了他日常生活的每個環節。

sentences.en: The lab performed a ______ analysis on the tissue sample.
sentences.zh: 實驗室對這份組織樣本進行了病理分析。

words.defn_en: a deviation from the normal:

sentences.en: The medical student is training to become a specialist in ______.
sentences.zh: 這位醫學生正在受訓,將成為病理學專科醫師。

sentences.en: Researchers study the ______ of the disease to develop better treatments.
sentences.zh: 研究人員研究這種疾病的病理,以開發更好的治療方法。

words.defn_en: an emotion of sympathy:

sentences.en: The film balances humor with genuine ______ in its final scenes.
sentences.zh: 這部電影在結局中巧妙融合了幽默與真摯的悲憫之情。

sentences.en: Her speech was filled with a quiet ______ that moved many in the audience.
sentences.zh: 她的演說充滿了一種靜靜的悲愴感,打動了在場許多聽眾。

words.defn_en: a paved outdoor area adjoining a house:

sentences.en: They hosted the barbecue on their newly built ______ .
sentences.zh: 他們在新建的露台上舉辦了這場烤肉聚會。

sentences.en: The house's ______ offered a lovely view of the garden.
sentences.zh: 這棟房子的露台能欣賞到花園美麗的景色。

words.defn_en: the plural form of patio, paved outdoor areas adjoining houses:

sentences.en: The new subdivision featured homes with spacious ______ .
sentences.zh: 這個新開發的社區裡的房屋都設有寬敞的露台。

sentences.en: Restaurants along the boardwalk added outdoor ______ for summer dining.
sentences.zh: 沿著木棧道的餐廳都增設了戶外露台,以供夏季用餐。

words.defn_en: exhibiting severe antisocial behavior and lacking empathy:

sentences.en: The film portrays a chillingly ______ killer with no remorse.
sentences.zh: 這部電影描繪了一個令人不寒而慄、毫無悔意的精神病態殺手。

sentences.en: Researchers study ______ traits to better understand criminal behavior.
sentences.zh: 研究人員研究精神病態的特質,以更加了解犯罪行為。

words.defn_en: a mental disorder marked by egocentricity and a lack of remorse:

sentences.en: Clinical assessments of ______ use specific behavioral checklists.
sentences.zh: 精神病態的臨床評估使用特定的行為檢核表。

sentences.en: The documentary explored the roots of ______ in early childhood trauma.
sentences.zh: 這部紀錄片探討了精神病態在童年早期創傷中的根源。

words.defn_en: a confused or muddle-headed person:
words.root_note: puzzle, of uncertain origin + pate (head), from Middle English

sentences.en: The old comedy features a bumbling ______ who misunderstands every instruction.
sentences.zh: 這齣古老的喜劇裡有個誤解每項指令的糊塗蛋。

sentences.en: He laughed at himself for being such a ______ about directions.
sentences.zh: 他嘲笑自己在方向感上簡直是個十足的糊塗蛋。

words.defn_en: exceptional or superior in a way that exceeds others:

sentences.en: The soprano's ______ talent left the audience speechless.
sentences.zh: 這位女高音卓越的天賦讓觀眾啞口無言。

sentences.en: He treated her with ______ kindness during her difficult recovery.
sentences.zh: 在她艱難的康復期間,他以無比的仁慈對待她。

words.defn_en: sharing the feelings of others, especially sorrow:

sentences.en: She sent a card expressing her deepest ______ after his father's passing.
sentences.zh: 在他父親過世後,她寄了一張卡片表達最深的同情之意。

sentences.en: The community showed great ______ for the families affected by the fire.
sentences.zh: 這個社區對受這場火災影響的家庭展現出極大的同情心。

words.defn_en: to enter someone's property without permission; a wrongdoing:
words.root_note: trespasser, from Old French tres- (across) + passer (to pass)

sentences.en: Hikers were warned not to ______ on the private ranch land.
sentences.zh: 健行者被警告不得擅自進入這片私人牧場土地。

sentences.en: The old prayer asks forgiveness for one's ______ es.
sentences.zh: 這篇古老的禱文祈求對自己過犯的寬恕。
